self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Smashed Stone (R5): Normal or Charged Attack hits increase ATK and DEF by 8% for 6s, max 4 stacks (can only occur once every 0.3s). Modeled at max stacks: +32% ATK, +32% DEF.

en.flavor: An ancient longsword discovered in the Blackcliff Forge that cuts through rocks like a hot knife through butter.
